{{Quote|Thank you for the loan of your starfighter.''"<br />"''Don't mention it.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]|<ref name="SWO1" />}}
[[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] flew an [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Interceptor/Legends|interceptor]] with [[Color/Legends|blue]] markings for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
[[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura's]] Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor was marked with blue striping and modified for higher maneuverability during atmospheric flight. The craft was armed with [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]], and used an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] for [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] and on-board repairs.<ref name="SWPM" /><ref name="Titanium" />

==History==
{{Quote|That's not his fighter&mdash;but that ''has'' to be Obi-Wan.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="SWO2">[[Obsession 2|''Obsession'' 2]]</ref>}}
[[File:AaylaBorrowedEta2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Obi-Wan Kenobi borrowing Secura's interceptor]]
Aayla Secura's extensively used her Eta-2 during the latter part of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], she commanded [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troops]] in combat as a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Jedi General/Legends|General]], yet on many intelligence-gathering missions and covert operations using her interceptor. Avoiding dogfights, she used her starfighter to protect Republic [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] by orchestrating careful defensive formations and chaotic breaks that would confuse enemy fighter screens.<ref name="Titanium" />

One such mission took her to [[Trigalis/Legends|Trigalis]], where she assisted [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in his [[Mission to Trigalis|hunt]] for [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. Then, when the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] gave Obi-Wan permission to pursue Ventress to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], Aayla lent her ship to him&mdash;along with the astromech droid assigned to her, [[R4-G9/Legends|R4-G9]]. Before he left, Obi-Wan promised Secura that he would bring the ship back "in one piece."<ref name="SWO1" /><ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|pack=Aayla Secura's Jedi Starfighter|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TACaaylafighter.asp}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
While this ship has been officially identified as Aayla Secura's interceptor, the ''[[Star Wars: Obsession]]'' series never depicted her flying it.<ref name="SWO1" />
